# Kalibrado Systems — sales deck (speaker notes)

## Slide 1 — The line stops when the parts do

Stock cards say forty units. The bin says otherwise. Purchasing finds out on
changeover day.

## Slide 2 — What we build

Barcode intake · guided cycle counts · reorder alerts · BIR-ready invoice
export. Deployed and supported from Quezon City.

## Slide 3 — The economics

Delivery firms in our bracket benchmark at 68.9 % utilisation and a 35.9 %
project margin [ev:C-2]; the build is priced from the same delivery model.

## Slide 4 — The ask

A paid discovery sprint on one production line. Pricing on request for
multi-site rollouts.
